categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily as a real estate investment trust (REIT) focused on real estate leasing. It invests in and manages real estate assets including office buildings and logistics centers, and generates income through rental and management fees. The company also engages in real estate acquisition, development, leasing, securities trading, and related rights management.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: As a REIT, the company does not engage in manufacturing but relies on asset management and investment strategies governed by the Real Estate Investment Company Act. It utilizes indirect real estate investment methods by acquiring equity in subsidiary REITs and real estate funds, focusing on stable income generation through property leasing and asset management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are institutional and retail investors seeking stable dividend income from real estate investments. The company’s end markets include office tenants such as SK Telecom and logistics tenants like Pasto Co., operating in commercial office and logistics real estate sectors in South Korea and Japan.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are concentrated in South Korea, specifically Seoul (Yeongdeungpo-gu) and Gyeonggi Province (Yongin-si), with investments also in Japan through a logistics hub leased to Amazon Japan. The geographic focus is on key urban and logistics hubs in these regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates downstream in the real estate investment supply chain as an asset owner and manager. It acquires and manages real estate assets and equity interests in other REITs, providing rental spaces to tenants and distributing income to shareholders, without involvement in upstream real estate development or construction.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding investments in domestic logistics centers and office buildings, as well as overseas logistics assets to diversify income sources. The company focuses on stable dividend generation, risk management through financial monitoring, and compliance with evolving regulatory frameworks to enhance market presence and investor confidence.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through rental income from leased properties, management fees, parking fees, and other ancillary income related to real estate assets. The company also earns income from dividends and capital gains on equity investments in subsidiary REITs and real estate funds.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company operates in the competitive Korean REIT market, which includes 386 REITs with total assets exceeding 99 trillion KRW as of September 2024. It is positioned among 24 listed REITs with assets totaling approximately 16.29 trillion KRW, competing with other institutional real estate investment firms and REITs focusing on office and logistics properties.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of September 2024, the company has total assets of approximately 853 billion KRW and equity of about 298 billion KRW on a consolidated basis. It has shown stable revenue growth with operating revenues around 20.2 billion KRW for the recent half-year period and maintains an investment portfolio valued at approximately 363.4 billion KRW. The company has issued bonds and maintains moderate leverage with ongoing capital raising activities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers investors stable and predictable dividend income through diversified investments in high-quality office and logistics real estate assets. Its differentiation lies in strategic asset selection including prime urban offices and logistics hubs, active asset management, and compliance with regulatory standards to ensure sustainable returns and risk mitigation.
